name: octaweave_update_event
description: Edit an event. FOR A REPEATING EVENT YOU MUST CHOOSE A SCOPE: scope='this' (the default) edits the single occurrence named by `recurrence_id`, splitting it out as an override; scope='all' edits the whole series. These are different operations and guessing is how people lose meetings — ask the user which they mean if it is not obvious. Pass `base_version` from the event you read.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

recurrence_id.description: Which occurrence you are editing, for a repeating series.
